key:
Identity-preserving production sprite sheet. Reference image is exact existing game character. KEEP his face identity, brown curly hair, burgundy gold-trimmed cape, navy tunic, leather bracers/belt/pouch/brown boots. Painterly realistic 2D RPG art same as reference. A strict 4-COLUMNS x 4-ROWS transparent RGBA sheet, exactly16 full-body side-view sprites looking RIGHT. Equal cells, generous gaps, feet and hands never clipped, no text, no lines, no floor or shadows. SAME character anatomy and camera scale in every cell: skull diameter, shoulder width, ribcage, hip size, upper/lower arm and leg BONE LENGTHS are IDENTICAL. DO NOT enlarge any body part when knees fold. Bent poses have a SHORTER full silhouette; that is correct. Chest/torso/head must not swell or shrink. No idle/start/stop frames. First pose is a moving contact pose, final pose is BEFORE the first contact. Strong clear alternating near/far limbs, close side profile not 3/4.
FIRST TWO ROWS = one complete 8-pose natural WALK cycle (read row-major). Near leg LEFT is subtly darker; far leg RIGHT subtly lighter, keep sides consistent.
0: LEFT heel forward at ground, RIGHT toe behind at ground; right arm forward, left arm back.
1: weight down onto LEFT foot, left knee soft, right toe pushes off behind, pelvis drops slightly.
2: LEFT foot supports under hip, RIGHT knee swings past forward, right boot lifted, arms passing near hips.
3: LEFT toe pushes behind while RIGHT leg reaches forward, right heel just ABOVE ground, pelvis rises slightly. NOT a contact pose.
4: RIGHT heel ahead contacts ground, LEFT toe behind; left arm forward, right arm back.
5: weight down onto RIGHT foot, right knee soft, left toe pushes off.
6: RIGHT foot supports under hip, LEFT knee swings past forward, left boot lifted, opposite arms passing.
7: RIGHT toe pushes behind, LEFT leg reaches forward with heel still slightly ABOVE ground, leading seamlessly to pose0.
LAST TWO ROWS = one complete 8-pose athletic RUN cycle. SAME torso width/length, head size and all bone lengths as walk. Torso leans only about8degrees, not a crouched hunch, elbows bent90degrees opposite the legs.
8: LEFT foot lands UNDER body, not a far heel strike; right heel recovered high behind near buttock.
9: LEFT knee compresses supporting weight, pelvis DOWN; RIGHT knee drives forward, both arms pump opposite.
10: LEFT toe pushes off BEHIND, RIGHT thigh high ahead, pelvis rises.
11: FLIGHT, BOTH boots off ground: LEFT heel tucked back high, RIGHT leg starts extending down/front toward next landing, pelvis UP.
12: RIGHT foot lands UNDER body, LEFT heel tucked high behind.
13: RIGHT knee compresses, LEFT knee drives forward, pelvis down.
14: RIGHT toe pushes BEHIND, LEFT thigh high ahead, pelvis rises.
15: FLIGHT both feet off ground: RIGHT heel tucked back high, LEFT leg starts extending under body toward pose8, pelvis UP.
CAPE trails with small secondary motion and remains same cut/length/color. Avoid broad lunge strides, body inflation, sliding feet, duplicate poses, different camera/scale, leg morphing, multiple arms, detached fragments. All16 are one SAME model with articulated joints. Maintain clear grounded support in contacts/down/push; clear BOTH-feet-airborne flight poses. Transparent pixels outside each figure, absolutely no background.

inbetween:
The attached 4x4 sprite sheet is the exact character, anatomy and camera reference. Draw ONLY 16 NEW INBETWEEN poses, in the same 4-column x 4-row equal grid. Do not repeat its key poses. First8 are midpoints of consecutive WALK keys0→1→2→3→4→5→6→7→0. Last8 are midpoints of consecutive RUN keys8→9→10→11→12→13→14→15→8. Same head, neck-to-belt length, ribcage and hips, identical limb bone lengths and clothing as reference. SAME SCALE AND SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, EXACT same model proportions. Folding a knee makes silhouette shorter, never zoom up or inflate torso to fill cell. Keep all16 figures fully inside separate cells, ample margins. Real transparent RGBA, no ground, no background or shadows. Maintain consistent near/far leg and opposite arm identities.
Walk mids0 weight transferring into left heel;1 left stance/right knee swinging past;2 left heel rises/right leg reaches;3 right heel about to touch as left toe leaves;4 transfer into right heel;5 right stance/left knee swinging past;6 right heel rises/left leg reaches;7 left heel about to touch as right toe leaves. At least ONE boot always planted for walk.
Run mids8 loading left foot with right heel recovered behind;9 left leg extending into push/right knee forward;10 left toe has LEFT ground, both feet airborne with right leg recovering forward;11 right boot descending under hips just BEFORE landing, left heel tucked up;12 loading right foot/left heel recovered;13 right leg pushing/left knee forward;14 right toe has left ground both feet airborne;15 left boot descending under hips just before landing/right heel tucked. Keep runner torso fairly upright with small forward lean, elbows90 moving opposite legs. No stretched silhouettes or generic lunge. Feet never dissolve or melt. Chest/waist thickness MUST stay the same as supplied keys. Same painterly historical RPG style, identity and costume. Output exactly16 NEW poses, not copies of old16.
